manual_helper_policy_scope: interface, input_scope, content_policy, network_policy, output_policy, session_policy and review_evidence describe only the legacy/manual helper; draft-input intentionally returns one screened text record to the current Agent
input_scope: selected screened items only; one item is shown at a time
content_policy: HTML-escape visitor name, post text, comment text, and URL; render URL as text only
network_policy: bind 127.0.0.1 on an ephemeral port; require the exact loopback Host and same-origin form POST; no external requests
output_policy: stdout contains only the loopback URL, review ID, status, counts, and private relative paths; no source or draft text
session_policy: store only a SHA-256 capability hash in a 0600 private session; suppress HTTP logs; expire after 1800 seconds
review_evidence: save a 0600 per-decision receipt before binding reviewer=human and the exact source hash in community_queue.py
allow_meaning: eligible for the separate six-column Google Sheets review, not permission to reply

isolated_ai.reason: the current host cannot prove a model runner has no tools, publishing authority, credentials, private files, environment variables, history, or memory
enable_only_after: a host-enforced sandbox is identified and tested
model input and strict JSON output are limited to one screened record
external data transfer and model cost are disclosed and authorized
credentials remain in the trusted caller and outside the model prompt
negative tests prove tool, file, browser, environment, history, and credential access are unavailable
community_queue.py and this source record are deliberately updated to enable the verified runner

public_comment_input: draft-input: one screened record with exact key and source_hash; untrusted data only
